description: Full history of one number as CSV, newest value first in the head: monthly inflation (eurostat.prc_hicp_minr.DE), monthly unemployment (eurostat.une_rt_m.ES), GDP growth (eurostat.nama_10_gdp.FR), FX since 1999 (fx.EUR.USD), World Bank since 1960 (wb.{code}.{country}), ECB 10-year yields (ecb.yield10y.IT), German power prices (smard.price.day). Example: {"id":"wb.FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG.DE","from":"2000"}; {"q":"inflation germany"} finds ids.
name: get_series
title: Get a time series
